My dear [Cobweb](../persons.html#675),
I am staying here with the [Secretary](../persons.html#351) and we both give our parting greetings to one of our oldest original [members](../others.html#104). I wonder if you will ever have time to continue the Composer series in the [Barnacle](../others.html#89)- I remember when [Christabel](../persons.html#329) told me how many lives you proposed, I was rather alarmed for the chance of the Barnacle living long enough to contain them all.

If you wish still to see the said Barnacle, please let Christabel know- though what is become of the present one is more than I can say
your affectionate
Mother Goose

[^1]: Tiny blue envelope 54mm x 94mm postmarked Ottery and Exeter 7 September 1865 and London S. W. 8 September 1865.
